cohort: 171 women with primary postpartum haemorrhage (PPH) out of 8,027 deliveries at a tertiary care center over a two-year period.
finding: Anemia was the major risk factor for primary postpartum haemorrhage (PPH), followed by multiparity and preeclampsia.
mod_finding: PPH occurred in 56 vaginal deliveries and 84 caesarean sections (51 emergency, 33 elective).
